# Uploader

**Figma:** Uploader/File-Upload, Primitives/Uploader/DragDrop-Field, Primitives/Uploader/File-Item (page 1581:17515)  
**Import:** `import { FileUpload, UploaderFileItem } from "@zen/design-system";`

Let users add files by dropping or browsing, then track each file's upload.

## Use it for
- Attachments, documents and media in forms (Drag & Drop).
- A single avatar or logo (Browse Button + photo thumbnail, Replaceable).

## Use something else for
- Pasting a link → InputField.
- Choosing from files already uploaded → a list or media picker.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Type | `type · extended` | dropzone (Drag & Drop; extended=false → 48px row) · button (Choose File) |
| Field | `label · caption · helpText · error · accept · multiple` | label Body/Small/Regular; caption says types and size |
| Files | `files[] {id, name, size, state, progress, caption, error, previewUrl}` | state: uploading · uploaded · replaceable · alert |
| Thumbnail | `thumbnail` | none · file (type badge) · photo |
| Actions | `onFilesAdd · onRemove · onReplace · onRetry` | 16px flat icon buttons |
| Item theme | `UploaderFileItem theme` | default (Surface + Pale) · overlay |
| Single file | `multiple={false} (default)` | the File-Item replaces the field; Uploaded shows as Replaceable; Replace re-opens the picker unless onReplace; Remove brings the field back |

Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/uploader.json`.

### FileUpload
Figma Uploader/File-Upload (1581:22708): Label → Drag & Drop field (Primitives/Uploader/DragDrop-Field, Extended) or a “Choose File” button → Help-Text → File-Item list (gap XSmall). The drop zone is a real button (Enter/Space open the picker) that also accepts dropped files; Dragover shows the 2px dashed Focus/Neutral/Subtle stroke.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma hasLabel. |
| `helpText` | `ReactNode` | — | Figma hasHelperText (or the error text when `error` is set). |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | — | Field-level error (State=Alert on the drop zone), e.g. "Max 800 KB". |

| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `onFilesAdd` | `(files: File[]) => void` | — | Called with the picked or dropped files; the app uploads them and feeds `files` back. |

| `thumbnail` | `UploaderFileItemProps["thumbnail"]` | — |  |

### UploaderFileItem
Figma Primitives/Uploader/File-Item (1581:22739): padding Medium, gap Small, Corner-Radius/Large. Name Body/Base/Bold · details Caption/Regular Neutral/Light (gap XSmall, 4px dot) · 8px Neutral progress while uploading. Alert switches to Negative/Subtle with the error as help text. Actions are 16px icons 12px apart (24px hit areas).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` (required) | `UploaderFile` | — |  |
| `thumbnail` | `"none" \| "file" \| "photo"` | — | Figma Thumbnail: none · file (icon-media-file 36px via FileIcon) · photo (previewUrl). Defaults to photo when previewUrl is set. |
| `theme` | `"default" \| "overlay"` | `"default"` | Figma Theme: Default (Surface + Pale border) · Overlay (Liquid-Glass/Normal + Effect/Overlay, no border — for photos, dark or busy backgrounds). |
| `onRemove` | `(file: UploaderFile) => void` | — |  |
| `onReplace` | `(file: UploaderFile) => void` | — | Replaceable: swap the file. |
| `onRetry` | `(file: UploaderFile) => void` | — | Alert: try again. |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
interface UploaderFile { id: string; name: string; size?: string; state?: UploaderFileState; progress?: number; caption?: ReactNode; error?: ReactNode; previewUrl?: string; }
type UploaderFileState = "uploading" | "uploaded" | "replaceable" | "alert"
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space | Open the file picker (drop zone or button) |
| Tab | Reach Replace / Retry / Remove |

## ✅ Do
- State allowed types and the size limit before upload (harness: uploader/accept-caption).
- Label the field (harness: uploader/needs-label).
- Show progress and time left; let users cancel an upload.
- Explain rejected files on the item and offer Retry.
- Use Replaceable for single-file fields such as an avatar.
- For a single file, let the File-Item take the field's place: omit onReplace to re-open the picker, or pass one that really replaces the file.
- Use extended={false} (48px row) where vertical space is tight, e.g. inside a table row or a dense form.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't reject files silently.
- Don't hide the browse option — the drop zone is also a button.
- Don't upload before the user confirms when files are sensitive.
- Don't pass a no-op onReplace (() => {}) — the Replace action would do nothing; omit it so Replace re-opens the picker (harness: uploader/no-noop-replace).

## Accessibility
- The drop zone is a real button (Enter/Space open the picker) that also accepts drops; errors use role=alert; icon buttons are labelled with the file name.

## Content
- Caption: "JPG, PNG or PDF. Max size of 2 MB"; errors say why and what to do.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uploader/needs-label` | warn | A File Upload has a visible label saying what to upload. | `zen-allow-upload-label: <reason>` |
| `uploader/accept-caption` | warn | When accept limits file types, say so up front in the caption or help text (types and max size). | `zen-allow-upload-caption: <reason>` |
| `uploader/no-noop-replace` | warn | Never pass a no-op onReplace; omit it so Replace re-opens the file picker. | `zen-allow-noop-replace: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
